Daniel Okafor-Reyes
Backend Engineer | Java, Kotlin, Event-Driven Services

CONTACT
[EMAIL] | [PHONE]

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Backend engineer with professional experience since 2019 building and maintaining Java and Kotlin backend services. Experience designing REST APIs, working with PostgreSQL and Kafka, automated testing, Docker, and Kubernetes on AWS EKS. Improved API reliability and data correctness through partner rate limiting, contract tests, and idempotent event processing. Seeking to bring this comparable-language experience to a Python-focused backend role.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
Backend: Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, REST APIs, OpenAPI 3
Data and messaging: PostgreSQL, Oracle, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis
Cloud and containers: AWS EKS, S3 and SQS (service user); Kubernetes; Docker
Testing and delivery: Testcontainers, Spring Cloud Contract, contract testing; small Jenkins helper scripts
Other languages and tools: Python (scripts for data fixes and Jenkins helpers; no production services); Go (learning project); Terraform (can read configurations; has not authored modules)

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Backend Engineer | Tejo Insurance Tech | 2022–Present
• Build Java and Kotlin Spring Boot microservices using Kafka, PostgreSQL and Kubernetes (EKS).
• Designed a versioned OpenAPI 3 REST API for insurance brokers to request quotes; added partner-level rate limiting and Spring Cloud Contract tests. The API supports 12 broker partners and around 400,000 quote requests per month.
• Implemented a transactional outbox and idempotency keys for Kafka consumers, reducing duplicate claim records from around 40 per week to zero over the following quarter.
• Built an internal Kotlin and Spring Boot service that renders policy PDFs from templates; wrote the team's Kotlin coding guidelines. The service uses AWS S3 and SQS.
• Participate in an on-call rota one week per month. Handled a major Kafka lag incident in March 2024; the incident writeup was praised.
• Run the backend guild meeting every two weeks, a responsibility held since 2024.

Software Developer | Viajar Online | 2019–2021
• Worked on the booking and payments parts of a large Java application.
• Raised test coverage of the payments module from 35% to 70% using Testcontainers, enabling safer refactoring.
• Extracted email and SMS notifications from the booking monolith into a separate Spring Boot service using RabbitMQ and Thymeleaf.

PROJECTS
OpenAPI Spec Diff CLI | Go | Side project
• Building a roughly 600-line CLI to diff OpenAPI specifications; available on GitHub. This is a learning project and is not production software.

CERTIFICATION
Oracle Certified Professional Java SE 11 Developer | 2020

LANGUAGE
English: Worked in an English-speaking environment at Tejo Insurance Tech.
docs.cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Backend Engineer (Python) role on Tessel Cargo Software's Routing & Tracking team. My production backend experience is in Java and Kotlin, and I am keen to bring that experience to a Python-focused role. Across these stacks, I have built REST APIs and event-driven services where correctness and reliability matter.

At Tejo Insurance Tech, I designed a versioned REST API used by 12 broker partners for around 400,000 quote requests per month. I also addressed duplicate claim records from at-least-once Kafka delivery by implementing a transactional outbox and idempotency keys; duplicate records fell from around 40 per week to zero over the following quarter. This work has given me practical experience with PostgreSQL, Kafka, API design, and the reliability challenges of processing event streams.

I also bring hands-on experience with automated testing, Docker, Kubernetes on EKS, and on-call support. At Viajar Online, I raised payments-module test coverage from 35% to 70% with Testcontainers and extracted notifications from a Java monolith into a Spring Boot service using RabbitMQ. I have handled a major Kafka lag incident and written an incident account that was praised. Tessel's focus on dependable shipment tracking and engineers owning the services they run makes this role especially relevant to my experience.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my backend experience could contribute to the Routing & Tracking platform. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,
Daniel Okafor-Reyes
